products.name: Cloud Services

Delivered through a mix of engineering talent and digital tools.

products.name: Core Enterprise & zCloud Services
products.description: Establishes, operates, and modernizes enterprise technology infrastructure, including mainframe, distributed computing, enterprise networks, and storage, supporting integration with cloud providers or migration to new platforms. Delivered via engineering expertise and managed services.

products.name: Application, Data & AI Services
products.description: Provides end-to-end enterprise data services (transformation, architecture, governance, migration) and application management, including enabling AI and generative AI tools, and managing enterprise applications as they migrate to the cloud. Delivered through consulting, automation, and compliance expertise.

products.name: Digital Workplace Services
products.description: Delivers technology infrastructure, mobility, security, and access solutions to support global workforces, including enterprise mobility solutions for seamless work across environments and locations. Delivered through managed services and digital tools.

products.name: Security & Resiliency Services
products.description: Offers comprehensive cybersecurity services (protection, detection, response, recovery) and business continuity planning, including cloud-based disaster recovery, to secure hybrid IT estates and ensure operational continuity. Delivered via experts, automation, and digital tools.

products.name: Network & Edge Services
products.description: Provides network and edge connectivity solutions, including strategy, assessment, transformation, and managed services for enterprise networks, leveraging software-defined and wireless technologies. Delivered through proprietary frameworks and managed service models.

products.name: Advisory, Implementation & Transformation Services (Kyndryl Consult)
products.description: Delivers consulting, advisory, and implementation services across all technology domains, helping customers design, build, and transform their IT environments. Delivered through expert practitioners and project-based engagements.

products.name: Investment Banking Advisory Services
products.description: Comprehensive financial advisory services including mergers and acquisitions, debt advisory, restructuring, and private capital advisory, delivered by specialized professionals globally through in-person expertise and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Equity Underwriting Services
products.description: Underwriting and distribution of equity securities such as IPOs, follow-on offerings, rights issues, and equity-linked products, requiring financial capital, regulatory compliance, and in-person execution by investment banking teams.

products.name: Debt Underwriting and Financing Services
products.description: Underwriting and arranging debt capital including bonds, loans, structured notes, and asset-backed securities for corporate, institutional, and government clients, involving financial structuring, syndication, and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Equities Sales, Trading, and Research
products.description: Execution, settlement, and clearing of equity and equity-related products, including research, electronic trading, derivatives, and market making, delivered via digital platforms and in-person expertise to institutional clients globally.

products.name: Prime Brokerage and Prime Services
products.description: Comprehensive prime brokerage services including financing, clearing, securities lending, outsourced trading, and technology platforms for hedge funds and asset managers, requiring regulated infrastructure and financial capital.

products.name: Fixed Income Sales, Trading, and Research
products.description: Sales, trading, structuring, and market making in fixed income securities, loans, and derivatives, including government, municipal, and structured products, delivered through regulated trading desks and digital platforms to institutional clients.

products.name: Alternative Asset Management Services
products.description: Management of alternative investment funds and strategies across asset classes, including multi-manager, equity long/short, and credit strategies, provided to institutional investors globally through directly owned and affiliated managers.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Finance and Servicing
products.description: Origination, underwriting, and servicing of commercial and multifamily real estate loans, including mortgage servicing and investment sales, delivered through joint ventures and regulated financial infrastructure.

products.name: Corporate Lending and Leveraged Finance
products.description: Structuring, underwriting, and syndication of senior secured loans and leveraged finance solutions for corporate borrowers, managed through joint ventures and involving both proprietary and third-party capital.

products.name: Wealth Management Services
products.description: Tailored wealth management and advisory services for high net worth individuals, families, and small institutions, delivered through in-person advisors and digital platforms.

products.name: Online Foreign Exchange Trading Services
products.description: Provision of online foreign exchange trading platforms and services to external clients, leveraging digital infrastructure and regulated technology subsidiaries.

products.name: Telecommunications Services
products.description: Telecommunications services provided through ownership in Tessellis S.p.A., involving regulated infrastructure and public company operations.

products.name: Real Estate Development and Investment
products.description: Development and investment in real estate properties through subsidiaries, involving physical asset management and regulated real estate operations.

products.name: Mitapivat (PYRUKYND®/AQVESME™)
products.description: An orally available small molecule pyruvate kinase (PK) activator, manufactured via chemical synthesis, for the treatment of rare hemolytic anemias including PK deficiency, thalassemia, and (pending approval) sickle cell disease. Delivered as an oral medication and distributed globally through commercial and distribution partners.

products.name: Tebapivat
products.description: A novel, orally administered small molecule PK activator in clinical development for the treatment of lower-risk myelodysplastic syndromes (LR MDS) and sickle cell disease. Manufactured via chemical synthesis and delivered as an oral medication.

products.name: AG-181 (PAH Stabilizer)
products.description: An orally administered small molecule phenylalanine hydroxylase (PAH) stabilizer in clinical development for the treatment of phenylketonuria (PKU). Manufactured via chemical synthesis and delivered as an oral medication.

products.name: AG-236 (siRNA targeting TMPRSS6)
products.description: A preclinical small interfering RNA (siRNA) therapeutic targeting the TMPRSS6 gene, intended for the treatment of polycythemia vera (PV). Manufactured as an oligonucleotide for sterile parenteral administration.

products.name: Arrive Point Network (Network-as-a-Service)
products.description: A hardware-enabled network of smart lockers and mini-cross-docks (Arrive Points) providing secure, asynchronous delivery and pickup points for packages, goods, food, and medications. Delivered as a subscription-based service, including installation, support, maintenance, and infrastructure services. Requires physical manufacturing, regulated infrastructure, and in-person installation.

products.name: AI Services for Last-Mile Logistics
products.description: Software and data services leveraging machine learning and artificial intelligence to provide insights, automation, and optimization for last-mile logistics. Includes edge computing, local processing, reverse logistics optimization, routing density, arbitrage, and growth forecasting. Delivered digitally via the Arrive Platform.

products.name: ALM Marketplace Platform
products.description: A software platform enabling dynamic pricing, scheduling, and optimization of delivery and pickup across the Arrive Point network. Functions as a marketplace for arrival/departure scheduling, space optimization, notifications, micro-weather data, local restrictions, and automation issue resolution. Delivered as a digital service to ecosystem participants.

products.name: Dedicated Internet Access Services
products.description: High-speed, bi-directional, symmetric Internet access delivered via owned and leased fiber networks, provided both on-net (directly connected buildings and data centers) and off-net (using third-party last mile circuits). Requires extensive physical network infrastructure and is provisioned using Ethernet protocol.

products.name: Private Network Services (VPN/MPLS/VPLS)
products.description: Private network connectivity services, including MPLS and VPLS, enabling secure point-to-point or multi-point connections for geographically dispersed customer locations. Delivered over the company's fiber network and, for off-net sites, via third-party last mile providers.

products.name: Optical Wavelength and Optical Transport Services
products.description: Dedicated, high-bandwidth point-to-point optical connectivity (10Gbps, 100Gbps, 400Gbps) delivered over the Optical Wave Network, using owned and leased fiber infrastructure. Requires specialized optical equipment and is targeted at customers needing dedicated transport without owning network infrastructure.

products.name: Data Center Colocation Services
products.description: Provision of colocation space and power in company-operated data centers and edge data centers, allowing customers to house their equipment and directly access the company's network. Involves physical facilities management, power, cooling, and security.

products.name: IPv4 Address Leasing
products.description: Leasing of IPv4 address space to customers, either as a standalone service or bundled with Internet access. Involves management and allocation of owned IPv4 address inventory under contractual terms.

products.name: Non-Nuclear Naval Shipbuilding
products.description: Design, construction, repair, and maintenance of non-nuclear ships for the U.S. Navy and U.S. Coast Guard, including amphibious assault ships, surface combatants, and national security cutters. This involves large-scale physical manufacturing at shipyards and in-person skilled labor.

products.name: Nuclear Aircraft Carrier Construction, Refueling, Overhaul, and Inactivation
products.description: Design, construction, refueling, complex overhaul, and inactivation of nuclear-powered aircraft carriers for the U.S. Navy, requiring specialized nuclear expertise, regulated infrastructure, and extensive physical manufacturing and maintenance.

products.name: Nuclear Submarine Construction and Module Manufacturing
products.description: Design, engineering, and construction of nuclear-powered submarines, including fast attack and ballistic missile submarines, as well as manufacturing of submarine modules under teaming agreements. This involves highly regulated, capital-intensive physical manufacturing and nuclear expertise.

products.name: Naval Nuclear Support and Fleet Maintenance Services
products.description: Provision of maintenance, modernization, and support services for in-service U.S. Navy nuclear ships worldwide, including mobile and in-house capabilities, and maintenance of nuclear reactor prototypes. Delivered through skilled labor and specialized technical teams.

products.name: C5ISR Systems and Operations
products.description: Design, development, integration, and management of command, control, computers, communications, cyber, intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (C5ISR) systems and operations for defense and intelligence customers. Delivered as integrated technology solutions and digital systems.

products.name: Cybersecurity and Electronic Warfare Solutions
products.description: Development and integration of cybersecurity, network architecture, electronic warfare, and related software and hardware solutions for defense and intelligence agencies. Delivered as digital and technical services and products.

products.name: Live, Virtual, and Constructive Training Solutions
products.description: Design, development, and operation of integrated live, virtual, and constructive training environments for military and security customers, connecting real and simulated scenarios to prepare personnel for cross-domain battle. Delivered through digital platforms and in-person training services.

products.name: Unmanned Systems (Underwater and Surface)
products.description: Design, autonomy, manufacturing, testing, operations, and sustainment of advanced unmanned systems, including unmanned underwater vehicles and unmanned surface vessels, for defense, marine research, and commercial applications. Delivered as physical products and ongoing support services.

products.name: Platform Modernization and Maritime Defense Systems Support
products.description: Maintenance, modernization, and life cycle support for maritime defense systems, including small watercraft, submarines, surface combatants, and aircraft carriers. Delivered through technical services and in-person labor.

products.name: DOE National Security Site Management and Environmental Cleanup
products.description: Management and operation of Department of Energy (DOE) national security sites and provision of environmental cleanup services for legacy waste. Delivered through technical, regulatory-compliant services and project management.

products.name: Branded Salty Snacks
products.description: A broad portfolio of branded salty snack foods, including potato chips, tortilla chips, pretzels, cheese snacks, pub/party mixes, pork skins, and ready-to-eat popcorn, produced in-house at company-operated manufacturing facilities and distributed nationally through direct shipments, distributors, and direct-store delivery routes.

products.name: Non-Branded & Private Label Snacks
products.description: Salty and non-salty snack products manufactured for partner brands, private label customers, and co-manufacturing clients, leveraging the company's production capabilities to supply snacks not sold under Utz-owned brands.

products.name: Dips and Salsa
products.description: Production and sale of branded and private label dips and salsa, including those under the On The Border® brand, manufactured in-house or via co-manufacturing and distributed alongside salty snacks.

products.name: Third-Party Branded Snack Distribution
products.description: Distribution and sale of select third-party branded snack products through the company's national distribution network, leveraging direct-store delivery and other channels to reach retail customers.

products.name: IMVEXXY (estradiol vaginal inserts)
products.description: A pharmaceutical product for the treatment of moderate-to-severe dyspareunia (vaginal pain associated with sexual activity) due to menopause, delivered as low-dose vaginal estrogen inserts. The product is manufactured and commercialized by licensees in the U.S. and internationally.

products.name: BIJUVA (estradiol and progesterone capsules)
products.description: An oral pharmaceutical product combining estradiol and progesterone for the treatment of moderate-to-severe vasomotor symptoms (hot flashes) due to menopause in women with a uterus. The product is manufactured and commercialized by licensees in the U.S. and internationally.

products.name: ANNOVERA (segesterone acetate and ethinyl estradiol vaginal system)
products.description: A one-year, patient-controlled, procedure-free, reversible prescription contraceptive vaginal ring system that prevents pregnancy for up to 13 cycles (one year). The product is manufactured and commercialized by licensees in the U.S.

products.name: Prescription Prenatal Vitamin Products (vitaMedMD and BocaGreenMD brands)
products.description: Prescription prenatal vitamin product lines, including authorized generic formulations, sold under the vitaMedMD and BocaGreenMD brands. These products are manufactured and commercialized by licensees in the U.S.

products.name: Human Capital Management (HCM) Software Platforms
products.description: Integrated, cloud-based SaaS platforms providing HR, payroll, talent acquisition, talent management, benefits administration, and workforce management modules. Delivered digitally and customizable for businesses of all sizes, with mobile and self-service capabilities.

products.name: Payroll Processing Solutions
products.description: Technology-enabled payroll processing services including calculation, preparation, and delivery of payroll, tax filing, and payment options (direct deposit, debit card, checks, ACH). Delivered via SaaS platforms or outsourced to payroll specialists.

products.name: HR Outsourcing (ASO) Solutions
products.description: Bundled HR administration and compliance support services, combining HCM technology with HR advisory services, available virtually or on-site. Allows businesses to outsource HR functions at varying service levels.

products.name: Professional Employer Organization (PEO) Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive employment outsourcing services where Paychex acts as co-employer, providing payroll, HR, benefits administration, risk management, and compliance, including workers’ compensation and health insurance. Delivered through licensed PEO subsidiaries.

products.name: Insurance Solutions
products.description: Licensed insurance agency services offering property and casualty, workers’ compensation, business-owner policies, cybersecurity, commercial auto, and health and benefits coverage. Delivered through partnerships with national and regional carriers and integrated with payroll processing.

products.name: Retirement Solutions
products.description: Retirement plan administration services including 401(k), SIMPLE and SEP IRAs, and Pooled Employer Plans. Services include plan implementation, compliance, reporting, online access, and fund selection, delivered via digital platforms and supported by financial advisors.

products.name: Funding Solutions
products.description: Financial services providing payroll funding and accounts receivable financing to small businesses and the temporary staffing industry, delivered through wholly owned subsidiaries via purchase of receivables under non-recourse agreements.

products.name: Partner Marketplaces
products.description: Digital marketplaces offering curated employee benefits, financial wellness solutions, voluntary lifestyle benefits, and access to third-party business applications, integrated with core HCM platforms.

products.name: Commercial Banking Services
products.description: A full spectrum of commercial banking products including debt capital (commercial loans), treasury management, and depository products, delivered through physical branches and electronic/mobile channels. Requires financial capital, regulated infrastructure, and in-person and digital service delivery.

products.name: Consumer Banking Services
products.description: Consumer deposit accounts and lending products, including checking, savings, certificates of deposit, and personal loans, provided via branches and digital channels. Relies on regulated infrastructure and digital platforms.

products.name: Mortgage Banking Services
products.description: Residential mortgage solutions for purchase, refinance, construction, or renovation of homes, delivered through in-person and digital channels. Requires specialized lending expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Private Wealth Management Services
products.description: Personal wealth management including investment management, private banking, fiduciary estate, and financial planning, delivered by specialized advisors. Requires financial expertise and regulatory oversight.

products.name: NLRP3 Inhibitor Therapies
products.description: Oral small molecule inhibitors targeting the NLRP3 inflammasome, including peripherally restricted (VTX2735) and CNS-penetrant (VTX3232) compounds, developed through proprietary medicinal chemistry and clinical trials for autoimmune, inflammatory, neurodegenerative, and cardiometabolic diseases. Delivered as oral medications following clinical validation and regulatory approval.

products.name: S1P1R Modulator Therapy (Tamuzimod)
products.description: Oral, selective, peripherally restricted sphingosine 1 phosphate receptor (S1P1R) modulator for the treatment of moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis and potentially other autoimmune diseases, produced via small molecule drug discovery and delivered as an oral medication.

products.name: TYK2 Inhibitor Therapy (VTX958)
products.description: Oral, selective allosteric tyrosine kinase type 2 (TYK2) inhibitor for the treatment of moderately to severely active Crohn’s disease and other immune-mediated diseases, developed through proprietary chemistry and clinical trials, delivered as an oral small molecule drug.

products.name: RNA-Targeting Antisense Oligonucleotide (ASO) Therapeutics for Genetic Diseases
products.description: Therapeutics developed using proprietary RAP Platform to design and deliver antisense oligonucleotides that target regulatory RNAs (regRNAs) to upregulate gene expression and restore healthy protein levels in patients with genetic diseases. These are manufactured via third-party contract manufacturers and delivered using established oligonucleotide delivery methods, such as intrathecal injection for CNS indications.

products.name: CMP-002 for SYNGAP1-Related Disorder
products.description: A lead RNA-targeting ASO therapeutic candidate specifically designed to upregulate SYNGAP1 gene expression for the treatment of SYNGAP1-related disorder, a severe developmental and epileptic encephalopathy. CMP-002 is delivered intrathecally and manufactured by third-party contract manufacturers.

products.name: CMP-001 for Urea Cycle Disorders (UCDs)
products.description: An RNA-targeting ASO therapeutic candidate designed to upregulate CPS1 gene expression to treat urea cycle disorders by increasing the activity of enzymes responsible for converting ammonia into urea. CMP-001 is manufactured externally and delivered systemically. Development is currently paused, with future advancement dependent on partnerships.

products.name: Discovery and Development Partnerships for regRNA-Targeting ASO Therapeutics
products.description: Strategic research, collaboration, and license agreements (e.g., with GlaxoSmithKline) to discover, validate, and deliver lead ASO series targeting regRNAs for multiple gene targets in neurodegenerative, kidney, and other disease indications. CAMP4 provides discovery and early development services, transferring data packages and know-how to partners for further development and commercialization.

products.name: Doxorubicin Microneedle Array (D-MNA) Therapy for Non-Melanoma Skin Cancers
products.description: A drug-device combination product using dissolvable microneedle arrays to deliver low doses of doxorubicin directly to skin lesions for the treatment of non-melanoma skin cancers, especially basal cell carcinoma (BCC) and Gorlin Syndrome. The product is physically manufactured using validated methods and is delivered via a patch pressed into the skin, allowing localized, minimally invasive chemotherapy.

products.name: Teverelix (GnRH Antagonist) Therapy for Advanced Prostate Cancer and Acute Urinary Retention
products.description: A long-acting gonadotrophin-releasing hormone (GnRH) antagonist formulated as a microcrystalline suspension for sustained release, administered via intramuscular or subcutaneous injection. It is developed for hormone therapy in advanced prostate cancer patients with high cardiovascular risk and for prevention of acute urinary retention relapse in men with enlarged prostate. The product requires pharmaceutical manufacturing and clinical administration.

products.name: Microneedle Array Drug Delivery Platform (SkinJect Platform)
products.description: A proprietary platform technology for transdermal delivery of drugs and bioactive agents using dissolvable microneedle arrays. The platform is physically manufactured and can be adapted for various therapeutic agents, including chemotherapeutics and potentially vaccines, enabling minimally invasive, localized delivery to the skin.

products.name: Quick Service Restaurant Franchising
products.description: Franchising of quick service restaurant brands offering pizza, ice cream, cookies, hot dogs, pretzels, and Italian food, primarily through an asset-light model where franchisees operate locations and pay initial fees and ongoing royalties. Products are prepared in-store and delivered to customers via dine-in, takeout, or delivery formats.

products.name: Fast Casual Restaurant Franchising
products.description: Franchising of fast casual restaurant brands focused on made-to-order burgers, Mediterranean cuisine, and related menu items, with an emphasis on fresh ingredients and customizable options. Franchisees operate locations and pay fees and royalties; food is prepared fresh and served in a fast-casual setting.

products.name: Casual Dining Restaurant Franchising
products.description: Franchising of casual dining restaurant brands offering chicken wings, American cuisine, steakhouse experiences, and sports grill concepts. Franchisees operate full-service restaurants with table service, bars, and extensive menus; revenue is generated from franchise fees and royalties.

products.name: Polished Casual Dining Restaurant Franchising
products.description: Franchising and direct operation of polished casual dining brands, including sports lodge-themed and barbecue restaurants, featuring scratch-made food, full bars, and enhanced dining experiences. Locations are operated by franchisees or company-owned, with revenue from fees, royalties, and direct sales.

products.name: Manufacturing and Supply of Food Products to Franchisees
products.description: Operation of a manufacturing facility that produces and supplies cookie dough, pretzel dry mix, batter, and other ancillary food products to franchisees and, to a lesser extent, third parties. Products are manufactured in-house and distributed to franchise locations to ensure consistency and quality.

products.name: Cordless Data Capture Devices (Barcode and RFID/NFC Scanners)
products.description: Cordless data capture devices incorporating barcode scanning or RFID/Near Field Communications (NFC) technologies that connect over Bluetooth, designed for integration with smartphones, tablets, and mobile computers. These are physically manufactured hardware products distributed globally and used in various industries for mobile data collection.

products.name: Camera-Based Barcode Scanning Software (SocketCam)
products.description: Software solutions that enable barcode scanning using the built-in cameras of smartphones and tablets, available as both free and advanced paid versions. Delivered digitally, these products are integrated into third-party applications via SDKs and serve customers with varying scanning needs.

products.name: Software Developer Kit (CaptureSDK)
products.description: A software developer kit that enables app providers to integrate advanced data capture features, including barcode and RFID/NFC scanning, into their applications. Delivered digitally, it supports multiple platforms and frameworks, facilitating seamless integration of Socket Mobile's hardware and software solutions.

products.name: Energy Network Hardware and Systems
products.description: Manufactured products and systems for supporting, protecting, terminating, and splicing overhead, ground-mounted, and underground transmission and distribution lines, including formed wire products, connectors, string hardware, polymer insulators, wildlife protection, substation fittings, and motion control devices. Delivered through physical manufacturing and distributed globally to energy utilities and related customers.

products.name: Communications Network Hardware and Systems
products.description: Engineered products for wireline and wireless communications networks, including outside plant closures, demarcation products, formed wire, pole line hardware, motion control products, and cable storage devices. These products are physically manufactured and support fiber optic and copper cable networks for telecommunications, broadband, and enterprise customers.

products.name: Specialized Industrial Hardware and Solutions
products.description: Custom hardware assemblies, pole line hardware, plastic products, cable dynamics/vibration solutions, connectors, tools, and urethane solutions for specialized applications in energy, renewable energy, communications, and cable industries. These are physically manufactured and tailored for unique customer requirements.

products.name: Solar Hardware Mounting Solutions
products.description: Manufactured mounting solutions for photovoltaic solar applications, including commercial, industrial, utility, and residential installations. These are precision-engineered hardware products delivered to solar energy customers.

products.name: Electric Vehicle Charging Station Foundations
products.description: Prefabricated, precision-engineered foundations for electric vehicle charging stations, manufactured and supplied to support EV infrastructure deployment.

products.name: Utility Asset Inspection Services
products.description: Drone-based inspection services for utility assets, including transmission and distribution power lines, substations, generation facilities, and communications assets. Delivered as a service using specialized equipment and expertise.

products.name: Wet Cleaning Equipment
products.description: Manufactured capital equipment for single-wafer and semi-critical wet cleaning processes in semiconductor fabrication, using proprietary SAPS, TEBO, and Tahoe technologies. Delivered as modular, configurable physical tools for front-end wafer processing.

products.name: Electrochemical Plating (ECP) Equipment
products.description: Physical capital equipment for advanced metal plating of wafers, including both front-end interconnect formation and back-end advanced packaging applications, using proprietary ECP technologies. Delivered as configurable tools for semiconductor manufacturing lines.

products.name: Furnace Equipment
products.description: Vertical furnace systems for high-temperature semiconductor processing, featuring proprietary quartz-based process chambers for uniform heating up to 1250°C. Delivered as physical tools for front-end wafer fabrication.

products.name: Plasma-Enhanced Chemical Vapor Deposition (PECVD) Equipment
products.description: Physical capital equipment for thin film deposition on wafers using plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition, equipped with proprietary chamber and gas distribution designs for improved film uniformity and reduced stress. Delivered as configurable tools for semiconductor manufacturing.

products.name: Track Equipment
products.description: Physical equipment for wafer handling and processing steps such as coating, developing, and baking, featuring automation and configurable software for defectivity, throughput, and cost optimization. Delivered as modular tools for semiconductor fabs.

products.name: Advanced Packaging Equipment
products.description: Custom-made, differentiated equipment for back-end wafer assembly and advanced packaging, including coaters, developers, strippers, scrubbers, wet etchers, and copper-plating tools. Delivered as physical tools tailored to customer requirements for packaging processes.

products.name: Services and Spare Parts
products.description: Aftermarket services and spare parts for installed semiconductor process equipment, including maintenance, technical support, and replacement components. Delivered through dedicated service teams and global support infrastructure.

products.name: Investor Communication Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive technology-driven services for regulatory, data-driven fund, corporate issuer, and customer communications, including proxy distribution and voting, regulatory filings, shareholder engagement, and omni-channel customer communications. Delivered via digital and physical channels, leveraging automated facilities and SaaS platforms.

products.name: Capital Markets Technology Solutions
products.description: SaaS-based platforms and software for capital markets firms, automating the full trade lifecycle (order capture, execution, clearing, settlement, regulatory reporting, collateral management) across multiple asset classes, with advanced capabilities in data management, connectivity, and AI/blockchain integration.

products.name: Wealth and Investment Management Technology Solutions
products.description: Integrated SaaS platforms and digital tools for wealth and investment management firms, including portfolio and order management, compliance, reporting, digital marketing, and advisor/investor workflow automation, supporting front-, middle-, and back-office operations.

products.name: Data and Analytics Solutions for Asset and Wealth Managers
products.description: Data-driven solutions providing investment product distribution data, predictive modeling, analytics, research, and compliance tools to asset managers, retirement service providers, and advisors, delivered via digital platforms and integrated with other Broadridge services.

products.name: Transfer Agency and Stockholder Services
products.description: Registrar, stock transfer, and record-keeping services for public companies, including support for corporate actions, abandoned property compliance, and communication with shareholders, delivered through regulated platforms and business process outsourcing.

products.name: Business Process Outsourcing for Financial Institutions
products.description: Outsourced operational services for buy- and sell-side financial institutions, combining Broadridge technology with operations expertise to support trade lifecycle, clearing, settlement, reconciliations, record-keeping, and custody-related functions.

products.name: 3D Printers for Plastics and Metals
products.description: Physical manufacturing of 3D printers using proprietary additive layer-by-layer processes for plastics and metals, delivered as hardware systems to customers globally.

products.name: Proprietary 3D Printing Materials
products.description: Development, blending, and sale of proprietary materials (plastics, metals, composites, wax, dental, biocompatible) for use in 3D printing systems, produced in-house or via third-party arrangements.

products.name: 3D Printing Software Solutions
products.description: Development and sale of proprietary software platforms for preparing, optimizing, and managing 3D printing workflows, including 3D Sprint for polymers and 3DXpert for metals, delivered digitally to customers.

products.name: Healthcare Additive Manufacturing Solutions
products.description: Provision of 3D printed surgical planning tools, patient-specific implants, surgical guides, anatomical models, dental devices (aligners, crowns, dentures), and related services, combining hardware, materials, and software for healthcare providers and device manufacturers.

products.name: Industrial Additive Manufacturing Solutions
products.description: Integrated solutions for industrial customers, including high-volume production and specialized, mission-critical components for industries such as automotive, aerospace, defense, and semiconductors, leveraging 3D printers, materials, and application engineering.

products.name: Advanced Manufacturing Services
products.description: Provision of contract manufacturing and production ramp-up services using in-house 3D printing facilities, allowing customers to test, validate, and scale production before transitioning to their own environments.

products.name: Maintenance, Training, and Support Services
products.description: Provision of installation, maintenance, hardware upgrades, software updates, training, and field support for 3D printers and related systems, delivered directly or via partners, including service contracts and remote troubleshooting.

products.name: Regenerative Medicine Additive Manufacturing (Pre-commercial)
products.description: Research and development of 3D printed human tissues and organs for transplantation, leveraging additive manufacturing and tissue engineering, currently in pre-commercial stages.

products.name: Plastic Reusable Containers and Pallets
products.description: Manufactured primarily through injection, rotational, compression, and blow molding, these durable plastic containers and pallets are used for storage, organization, and transport in industrial, commercial, and consumer markets. Products include small parts bins, bulk shipping containers, and specialty boxes.

products.name: Custom and OEM Plastic Products
products.description: Custom-designed and OEM plastic parts and assemblies produced using advanced molding techniques, serving industries such as automotive, recreational vehicles, marine, and niche consumer markets. Includes high-tolerance parts, assemblies, and specialty molded products.

products.name: Composite Ground Protection Matting and Event Flooring
products.description: Manufactured using compression molding and structural foam injection molding, these composite mats and flooring systems provide ground protection for industrial, construction, stadium, and event applications. Products are reusable and sold globally.

products.name: Consumer Fuel and Water Containers
products.description: Blow or injection molded portable plastic fuel containers, marine fuel tanks, water containers, and military ammunition containers, designed for safe storage and transport of liquids and materials for consumer and military use.

products.name: Plastic Storage and Organization Products
products.description: A range of plastic and metal storage bins, cabinets, shelving systems, and transport carts, manufactured using various molding and metal forming processes, for use in industrial, commercial, healthcare, and consumer environments.

products.name: Plastic and Metal Carts and Cabinets
products.description: Welded steel and stainless steel service carts, platform trucks, mobile work centers, racks, and cabinets for industrial and commercial use, produced through metal forming and fabrication processes.

products.name: Tire, Wheel, and Under-Vehicle Service Tools, Equipment, and Supplies
products.description: Distribution of a comprehensive range of tools, equipment, and supplies for tire servicing and automotive under-vehicle repair, including tire valves, changing and balancing equipment, lifts, alignment equipment, and hand tools. Products are sourced and distributed through regional centers and international branches.

products.name: Tire Repair and Retreading Products
products.description: Manufacture and distribution of tire repair and retreading products, including plugs, cements, patches, and sealing compounds, used by service professionals for safe and cost-effective tire repairs.

products.name: Reflective Highway Marking Tape and Traffic Markings
products.description: Manufacture and sale of permanent and temporary reflective highway marking tape and rubber-based traffic markings, providing durable and bright alternatives to paint for road construction and safety applications.

products.name: Metabolic-Based Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: Small molecule drugs targeting mitochondrial carrier proteins (SLC25A family) for the treatment of cancers, with a current focus on non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and pancreatic cancer. These therapeutics are discovered and developed using proprietary computational and in vitro screening platforms, and are intended for clinical use as standalone or combination therapies to overcome drug resistance.

products.name: Therapeutics for Inflammatory Metabolic Diseases
products.description: Small molecule drugs targeting mitochondrial carrier proteins for the treatment of inflammatory metabolic diseases, including metabolic syndrome. These are developed using the same platform as the oncology therapeutics, leveraging computational chemistry and in vitro validation.

products.name: MITOLINE™ Computational Drug Discovery Platform (Licensing/Partnerships)
products.description: A proprietary algorithm and cloud-based computational platform for generating reliable 3D models of mitochondrial carrier proteins, enabling virtual screening and drug discovery. The platform is offered for licensing and strategic partnerships to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies for their own drug discovery efforts.

products.name: Development and Sale of Solar Photovoltaic (PV) Projects
products.description: Development, advancement, and sale of renewable solar energy projects at various stages (from land identification through construction and operation) to third parties, primarily in Italy, Poland, and Germany. Projects may be sold at different development stages or held for long-term operation.

products.name: Battery Energy Storage Projects
products.description: Development and financing of industrial-scale battery energy storage system (BESS) projects, particularly in Italy, to support renewable energy integration and grid stability. These projects are developed and may be sold or operated in collaboration with partners.

products.name: Apparel
products.description: A broad assortment of apparel for men, women, and kids, designed and sourced through third-party vendors and sold primarily through company-owned stores, digital channels, and third-party arrangements. Products are manufactured externally and distributed via a global supply chain.

products.name: Accessories
products.description: Fashion accessories for men, women, and kids, including items such as bags, hats, and jewelry, sourced from third-party vendors and sold through stores and digital channels under Abercrombie and Hollister brands.

products.name: Fragrances and Personal Care Products
products.description: Branded fragrances and personal care products for men, women, and kids, developed and sold under Abercrombie and Hollister brands, distributed through company-owned and franchise stores, digital channels, and third-party partners.

products.name: Loyalty Programs
products.description: Customer loyalty programs (myAbercrombie and Hollister House Rewards) that provide members with rewards, discounts, and exclusive offers, designed to drive repeat purchases and higher transaction values. Delivered digitally and in-store.

products.name: Wholesale, Franchise, and Licensing Partnerships
products.description: Wholesale, franchise, and licensing arrangements that allow third parties to sell Abercrombie and Hollister branded products and operate stores in select international markets. Includes licensing of trademarks and select product categories such as eyewear and fragrances.

products.name: Oncolytic Immunotherapy Products (RPx Platform)
products.description: Proprietary, genetically engineered oncolytic immunotherapy drugs based on a modified herpes simplex virus 1 (HSV-1) backbone, designed to selectively replicate in and kill tumor cells and induce a systemic anti-tumor immune response. These are manufactured as 'off-the-shelf' biologic drugs and delivered by direct injection into solid tumors, either as monotherapy or in combination with immune checkpoint inhibitors.

products.name: RP1 (vusolimogene oderparepvec)
products.description: Lead oncolytic immunotherapy product candidate, a selectively replicating HSV-1 virus engineered to express immune-stimulating proteins (GALV-GP R(-) and human GM-CSF), developed for direct injection into tumors for the treatment of advanced melanoma, non-melanoma skin cancers, and skin cancers in solid organ transplant recipients. Delivered as a biologic drug, manufactured in-house, and administered in outpatient settings.

products.name: RP2
products.description: Second-generation oncolytic immunotherapy product candidate, based on the RPx platform, engineered to express an anti-CTLA-4 antibody-like protein in addition to the features of RP1, intended for local tumor injection to treat metastatic uveal melanoma and other difficult-to-treat tumors. Manufactured as a biologic drug and administered by direct injection, alone or in combination with checkpoint inhibitors.

products.name: RP3
products.description: Third-generation oncolytic immunotherapy product candidate, further engineered to express additional immune-activating proteins (ligands for CD40 and 4-1BBL, as well as anti-CTLA-4 and GALV-GP R(-)), intended to stimulate T cell activation for the treatment of solid tumors. Manufactured as a biologic drug for direct tumor injection; development currently deprioritized.

products.name: Local Television Broadcasting
products.description: Operation of more than 60 local television stations in over 40 markets, providing free over-the-air news, information, sports, and entertainment content, distributed via broadcast, digital, mobile, social, and OTT platforms. Content includes local news, network programming, syndicated shows, original programming, and live local sporting events.

products.name: National Television Networks
products.description: Operation and distribution of national news and entertainment networks (including ION, Bounce, Grit, ION Mystery, ION Plus, Laff, and Scripps News) via over-the-air broadcast, cable/satellite, connected TV, and digital streaming platforms. Revenue is primarily from advertising sales based on viewership ratings and demographics.

products.name: Distribution and Retransmission Services
products.description: Provision of access rights to local broadcast signals for cable operators, satellite carriers, MVPDs, and online video distributors, generating revenue through multi-year contracts based on subscriber counts and contracted rates.

products.name: Advertising Services
products.description: Sale of advertising time and digital advertising inventory to local, national, and political clients across broadcast, digital, and connected TV platforms, including core, political, and direct response advertising.

products.name: Sports Broadcasting Rights and Production
products.description: Acquisition and production of live local and regional sporting events, including exclusive media rights agreements with professional sports teams (e.g., Las Vegas Aces, Tampa Bay Lightning, WNBA), with distribution via cable, satellite, and over-the-air television.

products.name: Educational Program Management (Scripps National Spelling Bee)
products.description: Operation and stewardship of the Scripps National Spelling Bee, a large-scale educational program and event, including its broadcast and digital distribution.

products.name: Television Viewing Devices (Tablo)
products.description: Manufacture and sale of Tablo, a television viewing device that enables households to watch and record free over-the-air and streaming channels anywhere in their home without a subscription.

products.name: Data Delivery Services via ATSC 3.0 (EdgeBeam Wireless JV)
products.description: Joint venture to provide expansive, reliable, and secure data delivery services leveraging broadcasters’ network architecture and the ATSC 3.0 transmission standard for nationwide coverage to billions of devices.

products.name: Investment Advisory Services
products.description: Provision of investment advisory and sub-advisory services to institutional investors, mutual funds, ETFs, private capital funds, and individual investors, delivered through registered investment advisers and involving portfolio management, security selection, and strategy implementation.

products.name: Mutual Funds
products.description: Management and distribution of a family of mutual funds (Westwood Funds®), offering a range of actively managed investment strategies across equities, fixed income, multi-asset, and alternative asset classes, requiring regulatory compliance and portfolio management expertise.

products.name: Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs)
products.description: Development, management, and distribution of actively managed and index-based ETFs, including enhanced income and global equity strategies, delivered via digital trading platforms and requiring regulatory registration and portfolio management.

products.name: Private Capital Funds
products.description: Sponsorship and management of private investment funds, including energy secondaries and hospitality funds, providing clients access to alternative investments such as limited partnership interests in private equity and real assets, requiring specialized investment expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Wealth and Trust Services
products.description: Provision of fiduciary, trust, and wealth management services to high net worth individuals, families, and institutions, including financial planning, trust administration, estate settlement, and customized investment management, delivered through a regulated trust company structure.

products.name: Commingled Funds and Collective Investment Trusts
products.description: Sponsorship and management of commingled funds and collective investment trusts, pooling client assets to achieve economies of scale and offering diversified investment strategies, primarily for institutional and retirement plan clients, requiring regulatory oversight and portfolio management.

products.name: Managed Investment Solutions (Custom Portfolios)
products.description: Design and implementation of customized investment portfolios tailored to client-specific risk/reward profiles and objectives, using a consultative, rules-based, and adaptive approach, delivered to institutional and wealth clients via proprietary portfolio management systems.

products.name: Sub-Placement Agent Services for Private Placements
products.description: Acting as a sub-placement agent for private placements, facilitating capital raising for private investment vehicles and funds, delivered through a registered broker-dealer and requiring regulatory compliance and distribution expertise.

products.name: Firefighter Protective Apparel and Accessories
products.description: A comprehensive line of NFPA and CE-compliant structural and wildland firefighter protective apparel, including turnout gear, helmets, gloves, boots, and accessories. These products are manufactured in-house and delivered to fire departments and first responders globally, requiring specialized materials and compliance with rigorous safety standards.

products.name: High-End Chemical Protective Suits
products.description: Heavy-duty chemical protective suits and apparel made from proprietary fabrics, designed to protect wearers from highly concentrated, toxic, or lethal chemicals and biological toxins. These are manufactured in Lakeland's own facilities and sold to hazardous material teams and industrial users worldwide, requiring compliance with international safety standards.

products.name: Limited Use/Disposable Protective Clothing
products.description: A full line of limited-use and disposable protective garments such as coveralls, lab coats, and hoods, manufactured and sterilized for use in industrial, laboratory, medical, and emergency environments. These products are produced in Lakeland's facilities and distributed globally, often meeting specific cleanroom or infection control requirements.

products.name: Durable Woven Garments
products.description: Launderable, reusable woven safety garments designed for industrial and healthcare markets, providing alternatives to disposable clothing. These are manufactured by Lakeland and marketed to customers who prefer or require durable, washable protective apparel.

products.name: High Performance FR/AR Apparel
products.description: Dual-certified flame-resistant and arc-rated protective apparel featuring advanced moisture-wicking technology and lightweight, maneuverable designs. Manufactured by Lakeland, these garments are targeted at workers needing high-performance thermal protection in hazardous environments.

products.name: High Visibility Clothing
products.description: A comprehensive line of reflective, high-visibility apparel including vests, jackets, and hats, manufactured to meet ANSI and other international standards. These products are produced in-house and marketed to workers in environments requiring enhanced visibility for safety.

products.name: Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Cleaning, Repair, and Maintenance Services
products.description: Services for cleaning, repairing, and maintaining firefighter and rescue personal protective equipment, provided through acquired subsidiaries. These services are delivered to fire departments and rescue organizations to ensure ongoing compliance and safety of PPE.

products.name: Agency Residential Mortgage-Backed Securities (Agency RMBS)
products.description: Investments in mortgage-backed securities backed by pools of residential loans and guaranteed by government-sponsored enterprises (GSEs) such as Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, or Ginnie Mae. These are acquired and managed as part of a leveraged investment portfolio and delivered digitally through capital markets transactions.

products.name: Non-Agency Residential Mortgage-Backed Securities (Non-Agency RMBS)
products.description: Investments in mortgage-backed securities collateralized by residential credit assets that are not guaranteed by any agency of the U.S. Government or GSE. These securities are acquired through capital markets and may include senior, mezzanine, or subordinated tranches.

products.name: Residential Loans (including Business Purpose Loans)
products.description: Origination and acquisition of residential mortgage loans, including short-term business purpose loans for real estate investors, rental loans for non-owner occupied properties, performing and non-performing loans, and second mortgages. Loans are originated through proprietary channels and Constructive subsidiary, and may be held for investment or sold to other investors.

products.name: Single-Family Rental Properties
products.description: Acquisition and rental of single-family homes, including participation in government voucher programs. Properties are owned and rented to eligible families, with a focus on high-opportunity neighborhoods. Delivery requires property acquisition, management, and compliance with housing programs.

products.name: Mezzanine and Preferred Equity Investments in Multi-Family Properties
products.description: Provision of preferred equity and mezzanine financing to entities owning multi-family apartment communities, primarily as a capital provider alongside property-level operators. Investments are structured with contractual return features and protective provisions, and may include cross-collateralized structures.

products.name: Joint Venture Equity Investments in Multi-Family Properties
products.description: Direct common equity ownership interests in entities that own multi-family properties, typically as a minority or co-manager partner. These investments involve variable returns and are generally structured alongside experienced property operators.

products.name: Asset-Backed Securities (ABS) and Other Structured Credit Investments
products.description: Investments in debt and equity tranches of securitizations backed by various asset classes such as automobiles, aircraft, credit cards, equipment, franchises, recreational vehicles, and student loans. These are acquired through capital markets and managed as part of a diversified credit portfolio.

products.name: Robotic Magnetic Navigation Systems (RMN Systems)
products.description: Computer-controlled robotic systems (GenesisX RMN, Genesis RMN, Niobe) that use externally applied magnetic fields to precisely navigate the tip of flexible interventional catheters and guidewires during endovascular procedures. These are large capital equipment products installed in interventional labs and require physical manufacturing, installation, and integration with hospital infrastructure.

products.name: Interventional Lab Information Management Solutions (Odyssey, Synchrony & SynX)
products.description: Integrated digital information management platforms (Odyssey, Synchrony, SynX) that consolidate, display, record, and enable remote access to multiple sources of clinical and imaging data in the interventional lab. These are software and hardware solutions delivered as both on-premise and cloud-based systems, requiring digital infrastructure and regulatory compliance for health data.

products.name: Disposable Interventional Devices (Catheters and Accessories)
products.description: A portfolio of single-use disposable interventional devices, including diagnostic and ablation catheters (MAGiC, MAGiC Sweep, Map-iT), mapping catheters, and accessories (QuikCAS, Cardiodrive, V-CAS, iCONNECT), designed for use with both robotic and manual procedures. These are manufactured in-house and through partners, and are sold on a recurring basis for each procedure.

products.name: Integrated X-ray/Fluoroscopy Systems (Bundled Sales)
products.description: Bundled sales of third-party x-ray/fluoroscopy systems integrated with Stereotaxis RMN systems for hospitals establishing robotic interventional operating rooms. These are capital equipment products sourced through strategic partnerships and delivered as part of a comprehensive lab solution.

products.name: Product Maintenance, Service, and Software Updates
products.description: Ongoing maintenance plans, service-type warranties, and software enhancements for installed systems and solutions, delivered through direct and outsourced technical support teams. These are recurring service offerings recognized over the contract period.

products.name: High-Speed Internet Access Services
products.description: Provision of reliable gigabit fiber and fixed wireless Internet services to consumer and business customers, primarily in select U.S. towns, delivered via owned and partner infrastructure and billed monthly.

products.name: Telecom Software Platforms and Professional Services
products.description: Cloud-based software platforms and professional services for Communication Service Providers (CSPs), including subscription and billing management, network orchestration, provisioning, and developer tools, delivered as modular, flexible solutions to support telecom operations.

products.name: Domain Name Registration Services
products.description: Wholesale and retail domain name registration services, including new, renewed, and transferred domain registrations, delivered via a global reseller network and direct to consumers through online platforms.

products.name: Value-Added Domain Services
products.description: Ancillary services related to domain names, including hosted email, Internet security, WHOIS privacy, and monetization of expiring domains, provided through reseller and retail channels.

products.name: Web Hosting Services
products.description: Linux-based web hosting services for individuals and small businesses, enabling website hosting and management, delivered through the Exact Hosting Service platform.

products.name: Atherectomy Systems
products.description: Devices such as the Auryon Atherectomy System designed for the removal of arterial lesions and thrombus in peripheral arterial disease, manufactured and delivered as integrated hardware and disposable components for minimally invasive vascular procedures.

products.name: Thrombectomy and Thrombus Management Systems
products.description: Mechanical and catheter-based systems, including AlphaVac and AngioVac, for the removal of thrombi or emboli from the vasculature, delivered as single-use devices and supporting hardware for interventional procedures.

products.name: Thrombolytic Catheters and Infusion Systems
products.description: Catheters and infusion systems, such as Uni-Fuse, Pulse-Spray, and SpeedLyser, designed to deliver thrombolytic agents to dissolve blood clots in vascular access grafts and vessels, manufactured as single-use medical devices for interventional use.

products.name: Irreversible Electroporation (IRE) Ablation Systems
products.description: The NanoKnife System, a non-thermal ablation platform using electrical pulses to ablate soft tissue, delivered as a generator and disposable electrode probes for surgical oncology procedures.

products.name: Microwave Tissue Ablation Systems
products.description: The Solero Microwave Tissue Ablation System, consisting of a generator and applicators, used for the ablation of soft tissue masses in open, laparoscopic, or percutaneous procedures, manufactured as capital equipment and disposable applicators.

products.name: Endovascular Laser Treatment Systems for Venous Insufficiency
products.description: The VenaCure EVLT system, including diode laser hardware and procedure kits with disposable laser fibers, used for minimally invasive ablation of varicose veins, delivered as a combination of capital equipment and single-use kits.

products.name: Implantable Venous Access Ports and Accessories
products.description: Implantable port devices (e.g., SmartPort, BioFlo Port, Xcela Plus) and accessories for central venous administration of therapies and blood sampling, manufactured as implantable medical devices with proprietary features for oncology and chronic care.

products.name: Peripheral Interventional Devices (Catheters, Guidewires, Drainage Products, Micropuncture Kits)
products.description: A portfolio of minimally invasive devices including angiographic catheters, guidewires, drainage catheters, and micropuncture kits, manufactured as single-use products for vascular access, diagnosis, and intervention.

products.name: Endorectal and Vaginal Balloon Devices for Radiation Therapy
products.description: Devices such as the IsoLoc Endorectal Balloon and Alatus Vaginal Balloon Packing System, designed to improve patient comfort and tissue positioning during radiation therapy, manufactured as single-use, patient-specific medical devices.
